company.name: cryptostash
company.description:
Cryptostash makes cryptocurrency gifting simple, secure, and globally scalable.
We offer physical crypto gift cards and digital eGift vouchers that anyone can send via email, SMS, or WhatsApp—no wallet or technical knowledge required. Each voucher contains a pre-generated crypto wallet, with physical cards featuring a scratch-off layer to protect private keys and ensure cold-storage-level security.

Redemption takes just three steps: choose a card, redeem via our mobile-verified portal, and the crypto is securely delivered to the wallet on the card or eVoucher.

Our product lineup includes:
- Physical wallet cards for retail shelves and point-of-sale
- Digital eGift cards for e-commerce, affiliate, and corporate channels
- Custom-branded & B2B vouchers for bulk gifting, employee rewards, and Web3 marketing

Cryptostash partners with certified card manufacturers and logistics providers, not in-house production, ensuring high-quality, compliant output at scale.

Our infrastructure includes:
- Reseller & Merchant APIs
- Admin and End-User Portals
- KYC, AML & jurisdiction-based controls
- Integrated exchange partners 

We will support Bitcoin from day one and adding more cryptos like Ethereum, Solana, XRP, USDT on the way we launch.
We’re live in the UAE and preparing to expand into the U.S., Saudi Arabia, and Asia, tapping into growing demand for tangible, accessible crypto experiences in underserved markets.

Cryptostash is where Web3 meets real-world gifting—a turnkey crypto-onboarding engine at the intersection of fintech, retail, and blockchain.
